<?php

require __DIR__.'/vendor/autoload.php';
$app = require_once __DIR__.'/bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap();

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\College;

echo "COLLEGES AND THEIR COUNSELORS:\n";
foreach (College::all() as $college) {
    $counselors = User::where('role', 'counselor')
        ->whereHas('colleges', fn($q) => $q->where('colleges.id', $college->id))
        ->get();
    
    echo "- [{$college->id}] {$college->code}: " . $counselors->count() . " counselors (" . $counselors->pluck('name')->implode(', ') . ")\n";
}

echo "\nSTUDENT ACCOUNTS:\n";
foreach (User::where('role', 'student')->get() as $student) {
    $college = $student->program?->college;
    echo "- {$student->email} => College: " . ($college ? "[{$college->id}] {$college->code}" : "NONE") . "\n";
}
